pictureReviewMethod: Directly viewed all 17 sheets (204 captioned frames) of the first export. Compared samples against the corrected final, directly inspected all 21 changed final samples across five sheets. The other 183 final PNG hashes matched the individually viewed originals.
actualGameFindings: Townscaper opens on the rotating roofs. Portal shows the cube occluding the back surface and the glass/opaque border in separate cuts. Super Mario Odyssey shows the water and coins. The four edited motion windows occupy 23.4, 16, 20 and 13 seconds.
formulaFindings: Corrected SoA to three distinct arrays P/N/UV, with AoS per vertex. The corrected positions and labels are visible during their own spoken clauses.

On the final surface figure L, V, N and H share P. The view-space V points to the camera O; the corrected inverse-transpose arrow is perpendicular to the drawn surface tangent. T,B,N and n match the depicted directions before the formula is displayed.
The clipping edge crossing, interleaved UV fields, sphere specular response, camera frustum and near/far comparison remain visible over the fixed captions.
speechFindings: The actual 68-paragraph mix had full unprompted word recognition. Corrected scene 020 now distinguishes inside and outside (coverage .985 with no level warnings). Source take and final timeline have identical measured text coverage within the planned edit.

Compared the eight flagged paragraphs. The lowest coverage is the English book titles, float4 / SV_Position, and English/Korean pronunciation spellings. Scene 038's automatic transcripts render 보간 as 보관 in places; the intended term and diagram say 보간, with the same reading in the source-only and mixed recognition. Kept this as a grouped listening spot, without claiming a human heard the pronunciation.

Five 100ms low-reference-energy windows in the two Portal demonstrations coincide with game sound. Full paragraphs recognized with .984/.986 coverage. Final program -17.86 integrated LUFS / -2.53 dBTP. The corrected master has bit-identical decoded program sound to that measured version.
captionFindings: Both plain SRT tracks parse cleanly, KO 602 cues and EN 518. Final burned captions fit the fixed lower region in all 204 sampled frames, clear of the figure labels and game targets.
